results.text: A write starts as a proposal.
For registered Agent tools, low-risk context can be inspected inline; medium- and high-risk changes become proposals that require explicit human approval.

In the separate-execution preview, approval records review only. The original requester must use a separate execution step for a supported action; current authorization, exact proposal and target checks still apply. An AWS ECS request depends on a separately configured tenant-owned workflow. Approval or dispatch acceptance does not verify ECS execution, service health or rollback; each requires independent outcome evidence. The website preview grants no execution authority.

Separate requester execution is a local preview and is not production-activated. Your installed version may not include an Execute control. Check the controls and release guidance for your installed version; approval status alone does not prove that an action ran.
